inspiration.observed_pattern: A MariaDB ALTER TABLE adds a named FULLTEXT index with IF NOT EXISTS so the migration can be reapplied without a duplicate-index failure.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored InnoDB notes table, one conditional FULLTEXT index declaration, one repeated declaration, and an information_schema metadata read; search execution is removed so the minimized case isolates conditional FULLTEXT DDL.

fixture_notes: The notes table starts without a secondary index. The first conditional ALTER must add the FULLTEXT index, the repeated declaration must be a no-op, and the metadata read must expose both indexed columns.
determinism_notes: The table definition, index name, indexed columns, and metadata ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE incident_notes_min (note_id INT PRIMARY KEY, note_title VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, note_detail TEXT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB
INSERT INTO incident_notes_min (note_id, note_title, note_detail) VALUES (1101, 'Relay outage', 'The northern relay lost power.'), (1102, 'Battery audit', 'The backup battery passed inspection.')

steps.sql: ALTER TABLE incident_notes_min ADD FULLTEXT INDEX IF NOT EXISTS incident_notes_search_idx (note_title, note_detail)
ALTER TABLE incident_notes_min ADD FULLTEXT INDEX IF NOT EXISTS incident_notes_search_idx (note_title, note_detail)
